## 💬 Content

Those are automatically generated by the UI. You can sort of control it by setting the hotkey letter in the label eg. `(R) Relax`, `(S) Subdivide` etc.

A more transparent approach would be to create a separate modal that invokes the menu and executes an entry based on the hotkey, but the setup required for this may not be worth the time.
